The '''Essien landing''' was a Republic operation that took place when the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Essien]] was attacked by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. Former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Zayne Carrick]] took part in the battle alongside the [[Phaeda Militia]] and several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].
